content:
jamal: gpu-monitor-bot just sent a bunch of Xid/ECC spike alerts for us-west-2-gpupool, looks like 3 cards across two nodes.

gpu-monitor-bot: ALERT: sustained ECC errors > threshold on nodes: gpu-usw2-7, gpu-usw2-12. Xid 64/31 spikes. kv-cache invalidations increased. Suggested action: quarantine node(s).

sasha: can you paste the node names + npm logs? are these flakey GPUs we've seen before?

jamal: nodes: gpu-usw2-7 (nv4), gpu-usw2-12 (nv4). last occurrences on 2026-03-17T22:10Z. small mem ECC burst then driver Xid 31. not previously flagged for automated replacement.

alex: interesting — our operator should have cordoned those automatically. did the quarantine operator fail to create the taint?

priya: I checked the operator logs earlier, there was an error talking to kube-apiserver around 22:11Z for a short window. might have missed the reconcile loop.

jamal: here's the quick repro command I ran locally:
```
# get gpu errors
journalctl -u nvidia-persistenced | grep -i xid -n
# cordon + evict
kubectl taint nodes gpu-usw2-7 gpu-health=quarantine:NoSchedule --overwrite
kubectl drain gpu-usw2-7 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --force
```

sasha: we should NOT force-evict pods that have long checkpoints. prefer graceful eviction with 5m timeout then fallback.

oncall: @jamal can you run the quarantine flow for gpu-usw2-12 only, leave 7 for a canary manual investigation? I can scale replica sets temporarily.

jamal: starting with gpu-usw2-12 in 2m. will annotate pods with eviction-prep so controllers can checkpoint. tagging: `eviction:preparing-by-jamal`.

infra-bot: helm release gpu-health-operator v1.4.2 deployed to prod at 2026-03-17T22:05Z — reconcile loops should be fixed by patch 1.4.2 which retries on 429s. see changelog: https://internal.redwood/gpu-health/relnotes/1.4.2

priya: if helm patch isn't fully rolled out in us-west-2 yet then operator may still miss events. what's rollout status?

infra-bot: rollout status: us-west-2: 3/5 pods ready (progressing), us-east-1: 5/5 ready.

alex: ok. plan: jamal quarantines 12 now. sasha and priya: run post-eviction health check: `nvidia-smi -q -d ECC` and `dmesg | grep -i xid`. if no repeats for 30m we reprovision; otherwise replace card via RMA flow.

jamal: quarantine start: 1769009905. taint applied to gpu-usw2-12. eviction started.

sasha: eviction completed for node 12. some long jobs checkpointed fine. no SIGKILLs.

jamal: post-eviction checks:
```
nvidia-smi -q -d ECC on gpu-usw2-12 | grep -i error
# no ECC errors in last 10m
dmesg | tail -n 80 | grep -i xid
# shows two Xid 31 earlier, none in last 12m
```

priya: good. leave node quarantined and reprovision from the maintenance pool. I'll open a maintenance ticket and kick off an image reprovision + driver reflash.

jamal: filed MAINT-1248: reprovision gpu-usw2-12 + collect hw logs. link: https://tickets.internal/MAINT-1248

oncall: thanks — set alert to lower sensitivity for that pool while we reprovision so we don't auto-quarantine more nodes during the helm rollout.

sasha: follow-up: add a small backoff to operator reconcile (3 retries) and a last-known-good mark per node so we avoid flapping quarantines. I'll PR today.

alex: also add a canary config: if operator sees >1 node in same AZ in 15m, escalate to pager instead of auto-quarantine (to avoid mass evictions).

jamal: agreed. I'll monitor overnight and update the ticket with logs. thanks everyone :thumbsup:

gpu-monitor-bot: NOTE: alerts suppressed for gpu-usw2 pool for 30m per oncall request.

infra-bot: scheduled job: reprovision gpu-usw2-12 at 2026-03-18T03:00Z. will attach hardware logs to MAINT-1248.
